g.text: One group owns the oldest facts. The others arrived later.
The round takes the 50 oldest, so it holds one group.
Batches in one group must run serially: 1 call at a time, 3 slots idle.
Same backlog, same query — a wider window over it.
At most ceil(50 / 4) per group, groups visited oldest-fact first.
Four groups, four LLM calls at once. Order within a group is unchanged.
